comment: Single source of truth for the on-prem nodes. The clone script reads it, and Ansible will read the same file in Module 03 so the inventory can never disagree with reality. Sizing rationale is in docs/adr/0004-onprem-substrate.md.

network.comment: host_offset is the last octet of the static address. The subnet is DISCOVERED from the first clone's DHCP lease, so VMware's DHCP configuration is never edited. Offsets stay well below the NAT pool, which starts at .128.
